scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:home && npm run build:currency-converter && npm run build:bg-color && npm run build:password-generator && npm run build:rtk-todo && npm run build:todos && npm run build:theme-toggler && npm run build:ecommerce
scripts.build:currency-converter: npm --prefix ./currencyConverter ci && npm --prefix ./currencyConverter run build && mkdir -p dist/currency-converter && cp -R ./currencyConverter/dist/. ./dist/currency-converter/
scripts.build:bg-color: npm --prefix ./bgColor ci && npm --prefix ./bgColor run build && mkdir -p dist/bg-color && cp -R ./bgColor/dist/. ./dist/bg-color/
scripts.build:password-generator: npm --prefix ./PasswordGenerator ci && npm --prefix ./PasswordGenerator run build && mkdir -p dist/password-generator && cp -R ./PasswordGenerator/dist/. ./dist/password-generator/
scripts.build:rtk-todo: npm --prefix ./RTKTodo ci && npm --prefix ./RTKTodo run build && mkdir -p dist/rtk-todo && cp -R ./RTKTodo/dist/. ./dist/rtk-todo/
scripts.build:todos: npm --prefix "./TODos/TO DOs" ci && npm --prefix "./TODos/TO DOs" run build && mkdir -p dist/todos && cp -R "./TODos/TO DOs/dist/." ./dist/todos/
scripts.build:theme-toggler: npm --prefix "./Theme Toggle/themeToggler" ci && npm --prefix "./Theme Toggle/themeToggler" run build && mkdir -p dist/theme-toggler && cp -R "./Theme Toggle/themeToggler/dist/." ./dist/theme-toggler/
scripts.build:ecommerce: (cd "./LastProject/Ecommerce/Ecommerce Frontend" && npm ci --legacy-peer-deps && npx vite build) && mkdir -p dist/ecommerce && cp -R "./LastProject/Ecommerce/Ecommerce Frontend/dist/." ./dist/ecommerce/
scripts.preview: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 4173 --directory dist
